title: Coverage recovery Wave 03 part 4 — Pera and SubWallet lifecycle depth
notes: Candidate IDs are provisional. These records add dated first-party lifecycle depth and do not infer unresolved original launch dates.

events.title: Pera Wallet 5.7.0 released for iOS and Android
events.description: Pera Wallet announced version 5.7.0 as available for iOS and Android, adding NFT quality-of-life improvements, an updated asset details experience, and the Discover browser for Algorand dApps and markets.

events.title: SubWallet Extension v1.3.84 released
events.description: The official SubWallet Extension repository published v1.3.84, adding validator recommendations for native and subnet staking, chain-list updates including Polkadot Hub EVM support, and upgrade-related bug fixes.

evidence.title: Pera Wallet 5.7.0: NFT QoL changes and Discover-Browser all rolled into one!
evidence.notes: First-party Pera Wallet release article dated 2023-02-09; the indexed first-party profile states 5.7.0 was available for iOS and Android.

evidence.title: SubWallet Extension v1.3.84
